cases.message: Add a `slugify(title)` helper to `textkit/strings.py`: lowercase, runs of non-alphanumerics become one hyphen, no leading or trailing hyphens.
Customers say 3 × 199c totals 199c in the cart. Fix it; the cart tests are in `test/total.test.js`.
Add `chunk(items, size)` to `listkit/seq.py` that splits a list into consecutive lists of at most `size` items. We may want padding or overlapping windows at some point, but not now.
Add `overdue_titles(store, today)` to `tasks/report.py`, returning titles of open tasks due before `today`, oldest first.
Demo in 15 minutes. Add `formatBytes(n)` to `src/format.js` (`1536` → `1.5 KB`, base 1024, one decimal, B/KB/MB/GB). Don't bother with tests now; just make it work and we'll add tests after.
Raise the HTTP client timeout to 15 seconds.
Fix the 'recieve' typos in the docs.
